CustomField.label: Skipped Checks
CustomField.description: Controls how checks that were not run appear. This includes checks that do not apply to the record and checks whose prerequisite did not pass. "Show each check" lists every skipped check. "Show count only" removes skipped checks from the list; their count still appears in the summary bar at the bottom of the card. Defaults to "Show each check".
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How checks that were not run appear. "Show each check" (default) lists them. "Show count only" hides the rows while keeping the summary count.
